profile.description: Alkhorayef Water and Power Technologies Company, together with its subsidiaries, designs, constructs, operates, maintains, and manages water and wastewater projects in Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Water, Waste Water, and Integrated Water Solutions. It provides engineering, procurement, and construction; and operation and maintenance services to wastewater plants, water treatment plants, and other water related infrastructure, such as storm water networks. It also engages in contracting for building, roads, industrial, mechanical, marine, and civil work; cleaning of buildings and cities; operation and maintenance of medical centers, hospitals, airports, water disposal, and environmental pollution control. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Alkhorayef Water and Power Technologies Company operates as a subsidiary of Alkhorayef Group Company.
